subject: Regional host operator roster and KMS assertion request
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@medicore.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@medicore.com>, compliance@medicore.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: operator roster + KMS boundary diagram for EU hosting

Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement security review for the EU-bound pilot, our Security team needs the following so we can close our SIG/CAIQ review and confirm data residency controls:

- A roster (CSV) listing all "operator" level accounts that can access VPC peering, private connectors, or keystore interfaces for EU nodes. For each operator please include: name, role, country of residence, admin scopes, and whether access is via SSO or local account.
- A KMS key flow diagram (PDF) showing where key material is generated/stored, HSM/KMS boundaries, and any cross-region key export or wrapping flows.
- A short mapping (rows OK) that ties your SOC 2 controls to SIG/CAIQ items relevant to residency and key management.

Two clarifying asks: 1) Can you confirm that no unencrypted key material leaves EU-hosted hardware for our EU tenant? 2) Do you provide operator attestation signatures (DocuSign) for operator-level personnel?

We'd like these artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2027-03-24) to keep our onboarding timeline. If you need an alternate timeline, propose one and we can escalate internally.

Many thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Security Operations
Medicore Health

--
Attachment requests: please provide artifacts as download links or a secure folder. If any attachments are redacted for privacy, flag which fields were removed.

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@medicore.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@medicore.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: operator roster + KMS boundary diagram for EU hosting

Sanjay,

Appreciate the clear list — we can provide everything requested. Quick notes / proposed plan:

- Operator roster: we'll export a CSV with the fields you listed. For privacy, personal contact numbers will be redacted; country of residence and role will be included.
- KMS key flow: we'll include an HSM boundary diagram and an annotated flow showing where keys are generated, wrapped, and if/when any usage tokens cross regions. Short answer to your question (1): for EU-dedicated tenants we do not export unencrypted key material outside the region; all customer master key material is generated and protected in-region HSMs. I'll include the KMS policy snippets that enforce this.
- Operator attestations: yes, we have an attestation mechanism. We can provide a DocuSign envelope for operator attestation; alternatively, we can provide a signed roster with dates and titles.

Timeline: we'll assemble draft artifacts and place them in a secure folder by Tue EOD (2027-03-22) for your review, and provide final signed operator attestations by Thu (2027-03-25) if that works. If you need the DocuSign signed copies sooner, let me know and we'll prioritize.

I'll loop in our security engineering and legal teams to prepare the artifacts.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference

--
Evelyn: please see internal note below for owners and artifacts.

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: operator roster + KMS boundary diagram for EU hosting

Team — forwarding Medicore request (see below). Can you prepare the following by Tue EOD (2027-03-22):

1) operator_roster_v1.csv — include name, role, admin scopes, country_of_residence, access_method (SSO/local), date onboarded. Redact personal phone numbers.
2) kms_keyflow_diagram.pdf — annotated HSM boundaries and any wrapping workflows; highlight that CMK material is generated and stored in EU HSMs and that only usage tokens (no key material) leave region where applicable.
3) soc2-sig-crosswalk.xlsx — map SOC 2 control IDs to SIG/CAIQ questions related to residency and KMS.

Ben — please run the roster export and mark any operator accounts with dual-region privileges.
Irene — please assemble the KMS diagram and include the policy excerpts that enforce in-region key generation.
Marissa — legal, can you confirm the redaction policy + approve DocuSign envelope language for operator attestations?

Thanks — appreciate a heads-up if anything is blocking.

Per our plan, we've uploaded a secure packet with the artifacts you requested. Summary of what's in the folder and next steps: 

Attachments (in secure folder):
- operator_roster_v1.csv (CSV stub; personal contact numbers redacted)
- kms_keyflow_diagram.pdf (annotated HSM/KMS flow, labels for CMK generation and wrapping)

Secure links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGhK (shared with Medicore Security group, expires 2027-04-05)

- Operator attestations: we've created a DocuSign envelope for operator sign-off. Marissa has approved the language and Ben will route to the rostered operators.
- Redactions: phone numbers and personal addresses have been redacted from the CSV; we can provide a version with full contact details under an NDA if you require it.

If you'd like, we can set up a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow (Tue 2027-03-23) with our security engineering team to go over the diagram.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
